title: Speaking Practice 16 - Describe an Important Decision
description: IELTS Speaking Part 2: Describe an important decision you had to make.

stimuli.title: Part 2: Describe an Important Decision
stimuli.content:
You will have 1 minute to prepare and then speak for 1-2 minutes.

Describe an important decision you had to make.

You should say: what the decision was, when you made it, how you made the decision, and explain why it was important.

questionGroups.instruction: Speak for 1-2 minutes using the prompts.

questions.content: Describe an important decision you had to make.

explanation.sampleAnswer: The most important decision I made was choosing to study Computer Science instead of Medicine, which my parents preferred. I spent weeks researching career prospects and reflecting on my interests. Ultimately, I followed my passion for technology. It was difficult because I did not want to disappoint my family, but it turned out to be the right choice.

questions.content: Do young people make good decisions?

explanation.sampleAnswer: It varies. Young people can make excellent decisions when they have access to good information and guidance, but they may lack experience.

questions.content: Should parents make important decisions for their children?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I think parents should guide and advise, but ultimately let children make their own choices. This helps them develop responsibility and independence.
